prompt: Our investment research team needs a consolidated report on the top-performing domestic equity funds for this year. Please identify the top 3 equity funds ranked by their 1-year performance, then for each of those funds pull their full profile (current unit value, daily movement, multi-period returns, fund manager, scale) as well as their 1-year historical trend with risk metrics, and their current top holdings breakdown. Combine all of this into a single file called equity_fund_report.json that our quant team can load directly into their pipeline.
